WHY UNITED IS THE WORLD'S MOST POPULAR AIR LINE!
Last year United Air Lines flew twice as many passenger - miles as any other air line in the
world! This year United is setting new world's air travel records, carrying more passengers
more miles than ever before. Now, more than ever, it's the world's most popular air line.
Why is United the choice of more air travellers? Satisfied passengers give these reasons:
"I like the comfortable altitudes at which
United flies...
"Courteous and kindly attention from all
employees...
"My flying experience covers five years in
many different types of planes, but the de-
pendability of your Boeings impresses me...
"I have traveled extensively in Europe, Asia
and America but never have I encountered
better service than that of United Air Lines...
"Your stewardess service makes flying
much more enjoyable and interesting..
"I have used United on more than 50 dif-
ferent trips, and your service has been con-
sistently efficient, dependable and pleasant...
"Your pilots and equipment inspire confi-
dence, your unexcelled experience assures it...
"I have been made to feel that the comfort
and pleasure of the passenger is the one aim
of the management...
